title: Change Mission section heading to Hindi text

requirements.text: In the Mission component, replace the heading text at XPath /html[1]/body[1]/div[1]/div[1]/main[1]/div[1]/section[2]/div[1]/div[1]/h2[1] with 'हमारा पवित्र मिशन'
acceptanceCriteria: The h2 heading element in the Mission component displays 'हमारा पवित्र मिशन'
The heading is properly rendered with UTF-8 encoding showing Hindi Devanagari script
The heading maintains its existing styling and positioning in the Mission section

constraints: Only modify the specific h2 heading element at the provided XPath
Do not change any other text or elements in the Mission component
Preserve all existing styling and layout
nonGoals: Translating any other text on the page
Modifying the Mission component structure or styling
